Deterministic lock ordering

I am implementing a batch command that updates several saved links and inserts one durable job per link. Two requests can contain the same identifiers in a different order.

Should the command preserve request order, or should it sort identifiers before acquiring row locks? I want the response to preserve input order while the transaction uses one canonical lock order.

The current design sorts a copy of the identifiers for locking, stores results by identifier, and then reconstructs the response in request order. Is there another invariant I should document?
